decision: Owner decision 2026-10-01 (question 40 (a), AGENTS.md section 5): the web build decodes Brotli with Google's MIT decoder, vendored here; the download was approved by the user in the Core session on 2026-10-02.
consumer: src/compression/brotli.ts loads it only in a realm without node:zlib (a browser, a web worker).

edits.change: renamed from decode.js, with a `// @ts-nocheck` line after the copyright header, so the package's tsc (src/**/*.ts) emits the JavaScript into dist as it is

decode() throws RangeError('Brotli output exceeds maxOutputLength') once its output passes options.maxOutputLength, checked after each 16 KiB chunk, so a stream that expands without end stops near its bound instead of filling memory
